evidence.evidence: Properties configure server URL, PIN/reported actor, explicit transport and printer/file destination; no concrete operational config values collected.
Transport switch restricted to network/serial/windows/file; route enum validated and canonicalized, poll>=1; host/queue/port basic checks only.
Config loaded from caller path JSON, no signature/ACL check/encryption in loader.
First nonflag CLI arg chooses config, otherwise app base appsettings.json; Validate failures stop before startup.

records.inputs: Local CLI config path and JSON properties; no remote request chooses transport at runtime.
records.outputs_side_effects: Normal startup can transmit credential to configured server and ticket bytes to configured sink.
records.legitimate_purpose: Explicit station setup, default transport=file and backend localhost.
records.trust_boundaries: Trusted station config controls secrets and destinations; config access controls/deployment outside this source review.
counterevidence_limitations: PIN public JSON property may be plaintext in deployment config; no actual config or PIN read.
Validation does not require HTTPS/allowlist host or validate printer TCP range/timeouts/raster dimensions here.
Server login result actor identity is not compared to ReportedByUserId in PrintServerClient; normal middleware can reject mismatched report actor, not arbitrary identity-proof success.

records.category: Print test mode and periodic queue worker

evidence.evidence: Explicit --test-print branch directly sends rendered sample to configured physical/file transport; not executed.
Route-specific named Global mutex prevents same-host second worker; authenticates configured PIN once then constructs processor/store.
CtrlC cancellation; serial DrainAsync then configured delay, failures logged and next poll continues.

records.inputs: Local CLI flag and config; backend pending queue determines normal jobs.
records.outputs_side_effects: Physical printing/attempt reporting in normal loop; test mode bypasses API queue/auth after config validation by explicit request.
records.legitimate_purpose: Visible queue worker and installer printer test, not covert malicious timer.
records.trust_boundaries: OS/process config and API jobs to print outputs; same-host mutex not distributed queue claim.
counterevidence_limitations: --test-print is physically side-effectful; documentation/test mode name does not make it safe to run without owner authorization.
Same route on different machines can still compete; mutex local protection only.
App top-level worker statements not all represented in callable index; exact source spans retained without function-count invention.

evidence.evidence: Enum canonical route used in base-directory journal path, migrates legacy dictionary records; corrupt load throws and stops rather than silently reprint.
Attempts written plain JSON to temp then move; local lock serializes in-process modifications.

records.inputs: AppContext.BaseDirectory and validated route, server job IDs/attempt outcomes/errors.
records.outputs_side_effects: Durable local print-attempt journal and migration copies; no raw ticket receipt payload intentionally stored here.
records.legitimate_purpose: Prevent duplicate physical printing after lost report acknowledgement.
records.trust_boundaries: Local filesystem affects whether jobs reprinted/reported; errors may contain operational detail.
counterevidence_limitations: No actual journal read; records could contain sensitive errors/IDs and must stay out of Git.
Local gate not crossprocess integrity/authentication; config/shared directory ACL unverified.
Failure timing and power-loss duplication windows addressed by printing audit, not cleared by atomic temp-move pattern.
